330	/-! ### The colength modules and the glued equalizer -/
331	
332	/-- The chart-local colength module `Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_j)`, an `R`-algebra through
333	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`. -/
334	noncomputable abbrev colength (j : A.index) : Type u :=
335	  Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span {A.eqn j}
336	
337	/-- The symmetric overlap ideal: both equations restricted to the piece overlap. The
338	two restrictions generate the same ideal (the equations differ by units on overlaps
339	through the refinement witness), but the symmetric span needs no transport in the
340	DEFINITION. -/
341	noncomputable abbrev ovlIdeal (i j : A.index) :
342	    Ideal Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) :=
343	  Ideal.span
344	    {relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_left : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i),
345	     relResAlgHom C R (inf_le_right : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces j) (A.eqn j)}
346	
347	/-- The overlap colength module `Γ(D(h_i) ⊓ D(h_j)) ⧸ (f_i, f_j)`. -/
348	noncomputable abbrev ovlColength (i j : A.index) : Type u :=
349	  Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) ⧸ A.ovlIdeal i j
350	
351	/-- The induced `R`-algebra map `colength i → ovlColength i j` (restrict, then quotient;
352	the ideal of `f_i` lands in the symmetric span). -/
353	noncomputable def toOvlLeft (i j : A.index) : A.colength i →ₐ[R] A.ovlColength i j :=
354	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
355	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (A.ovlIdeal i j)).comp (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left))
356	    (by
357	      intro a ha
358	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
359	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
360	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
361	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R
362	          (inf_le_left : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i)
363	          ∈ A.ovlIdeal i j :=
364	        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
365	      rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, zero_mul])
366	
367	/-- The induced `R`-algebra map `colength j → ovlColength i j`. -/
368	noncomputable def toOvlRight (i j : A.index) : A.colength j →ₐ[R] A.ovlColength i j :=
369	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.eqn j})
370	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (A.ovlIdeal i j)).comp (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right))
371	    (by
372	      intro a ha
373	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
374	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
375	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
376	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R
377	          (inf_le_right : A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces j) (A.eqn j)
378	          ∈ A.ovlIdeal i j :=
379	        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
380	      rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, zero_mul])
381	
382	/-- The product of the chart-local colength modules (an `abbrev`, so the `Pi.module`
383	instances apply directly — probe finding, spec §1b(iii)). -/
384	noncomputable abbrev chartProd : Type u := ∀ j : A.index, A.colength j
385	
386	/-- The product of the overlap colength modules over ordered index pairs. -/
387	noncomputable abbrev ovlProd : Type u := ∀ p : A.index × A.index, A.ovlColength p.1 p.2
388	
389	/-- The left arrow of the equalizer: restrict the `p.1` component to each overlap. -/
390	noncomputable def deltaLeft : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
391	  LinearMap.pi
392	    (fun p : A.index × A.index => (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.1)
393	
394	/-- The right arrow of the equalizer: restrict the `p.2` component to each overlap. -/
395	noncomputable def deltaRight : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
396	  LinearMap.pi
397	    (fun p : A.index × A.index => (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.2)
398	
399	/-- **The glued colength module `W(d)`** (worksheet §1.1 (c2)): the equalizer of the two
400	overlap-restriction arrows on the product of chart-local colengths, spelled as the
401	kernel of their difference (so the `FlatCokernel` base-change keystone applies
402	verbatim); the equalizer description is `mem_gluedSubmodule_iff`. -/
403	noncomputable def gluedSubmodule : Submodule R A.chartProd :=
404	  LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)
405	
406	/-- The equalizer description of the glued colength module: componentwise agreement of
407	the two overlap restrictions. -/
408	lemma mem_gluedSubmodule_iff (s : A.chartProd) :
409	    s ∈ A.gluedSubmodule ↔ ∀ p : A.index × A.index,
410	      A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) = A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
411	  simp only [gluedSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero,
412	    funext_iff, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
413	    Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
414	
415	/-- The glued colength module, as a type. -/
416	noncomputable abbrev Glued : Type u := ↥A.gluedSubmodule
417	
418	/-! ### The certificate -/
419	
420	/-- **The colength certificate** (worksheet §1.1 (c1)/(c2) in the spec-dd-1 §1c frozen
421	spelling): chart-local colengths finite projective over `R` (c1); the glued module
422	finite projective of constant fibre rank `n` — honest finrank at every prime through
423	`Module.rankAtStalk` (c2); and the two flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4) that make
424	certificates base-change along ARBITRARY test maps (trivial over a field; transported
425	by right-exactness; consumed by `FlatCokernel.tensorKer_bijective_of_flat_coker`). -/
426	structure IsCertified (n : ℕ) : Prop where
427	  /-- (c1) Each chart-local colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
428	  finite_colength : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)
429	  /-- (c1) Each chart-local colength module is projective over `R`. -/
430	  projective_colength : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)
431	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is a finite `R`-module. -/
432	  finite_glued : Module.Finite R A.Glued
433	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module is projective over `R`. -/
434	  projective_glued : Module.Projective R A.Glued
435	  /-- (c2) The glued colength module has constant fibre rank `n`. -/
436	  rankAtStalk_glued : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk A.Glued p = n
437	  /-- (c3) The cokernel of `W(d) ↪ Π_j colength j` is flat. -/
438	  flat_coker_incl : Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)
439	  /-- (c4) The cokernel of the difference arrow is flat. -/
440	  flat_coker_diff :
441	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
442	
443	end DivisorAdaptation
444	
445	/-! ## The certified family and the divisor-functor value -/
446	
447	variable (n : ℕ)
448	
449	/-- **A certified divisor family of degree `n` over the test ring `R`** (the worksheet's
450	(D1) pair `(d, c)`): a local-equation system with a certified finite chart
451	adaptation. -/
452	structure CertifiedDivisorFamily [IsAffineHom π] : Type u where
453	  /-- The local-equation system on the relative curve. -/
454	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
455	  /-- The finite chart adaptation refining it. -/
456	  adaptation : DivisorAdaptation C R π eqns
457	  /-- The colength certificate of degree `n`. -/
458	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n
459	
460	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on certified families: the underlying local-equation
461	systems cut the same divisor (`Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq`); the adaptation and
462	certificate are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
463	def divFamSetoid [IsAffineHom π] : Setoid (CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) where
464	  r F G := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq F.eqns G.eqns
465	  iseqv :=
466	    ⟨fun F => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl F.eqns,
467	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
468	
469	/-- **The divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`** (worksheet §1.1): certified
470	divisor families of degree `n` up to divisor equality. A `Type u` quotient — the
471	carrier the affine-opens-limit vehicle ranges over. -/
472	def DivFam [IsAffineHom π] : Type u := Quotient (divFamSetoid C R π n)
473	
474	namespace DivFam
475	
476	variable {C R π n} [IsAffineHom π]
477	
478	/-- The class of a certified family. -/
479	def mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : DivFam C R π n :=
480	  Quotient.mk (divFamSetoid C R π n) F
481	
482	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {F G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n} :
483	    mk F = mk G ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq F.eqns G.eqns :=
484	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamSetoid C R π n)
485	
486	/-- **The Picard class of a divisor family** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on the quotient by
487	the class laws (`picClass_eq_of_divEq`). This is the Abel hook DAT-C consumes. -/
488	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFam C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
489	  Quotient.lift (fun F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n => F.eqns.picClass)
490	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
491	
492	@[simp]
493	lemma picClass_mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) :
494	    picClass (mk F) = F.eqns.picClass :=
495	  rfl
496	
497	end DivFam
498	
499	end AlgebraicGeometry

10	/-!
11	# F4 — the backward direction of `divRepAff` at the Zar layer
12	(`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §2.1, steps 1, 3, 5, 6)
13	
14	A locally certified divisor class `F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g` over an affine test `S`
15	classifies to a **unique** morphism `overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g` — the content of
16	`divRepAff.symm`.  Construction: the composite certificate × frame cover of the Kit
17	(`DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover`), `divClassify` fired at each certified
18	representative with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`), the glue by
19	`Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms` with overlap agreement through the clause-transport
20	layer, and the Over packaging by `divSchemeOverHomMk` (F2).
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsDivRepClassify` — **the characterizing clause** (the
23	  refinement-stable form F6 consumes): over EVERY `k`/`S`-tower test `T` carrying a
24	  certified representative `G` of the restricted class and a pair-chart framing of
25	  `ε (DivFam.mk G)`, the morphism chart-factors.  No localization hypothesis on `T`
26	  — stability under refinement of covers and change of representative is built into
27	  the quantifier.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divClassifyZar` — **the ∃!-keystone**: `F₀` classifies to a
29	  unique clause-satisfier `Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` (overlap layer:
30	  `Picard/DivRepClassifyZarCompat.lean`).
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepClassifyZar` — **the keystone map**
32	  `DivFamZar C S π g → (overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g)`, with the characterizing
33	  lemma `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify` and the well-definedness lemma

193	        ≫ v' ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)

198	    hv' (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)

201	
202	include hO hχ in
203	/-- **The ∃!-keystone of the backward direction** (w4-ddr9 §2.1): a locally
204	certified divisor class over an affine test classifies to a UNIQUE morphism
205	`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
206	theorem divClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
207	    ∃! v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
208	        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
209	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
210	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
211	      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
212	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
213	  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' =>
214	    isDivRepClassify_unique hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ hv' hv⟩
215	
216	/-! ## The Over packaging -/
217	
218	include hO hχ in
219	/-- **The classified morphism, packaged over `Spec k`**: the clause-satisfier carries
220	the Over-triangle — its `divSchemeι`-composite is chart-presented over the composite
221	certificate × frame cover, so `divSchemeOverHomMk` (F2) applies. -/
222	theorem exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
223	    ∃ u : overSpec k S ⟶
224	        divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)

10	/-!
11	# Locally certified divisor families: the `DivFamZar` carrier (DD-2 stage S5b)
12	
13	The Addendum-2 repair of the divisor-functor carrier (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`,
14	Addendum 2): the globally-certified `DivFam` is not a Zariski sheaf — the diagonal
15	divisor over `Γ(C \ pt)` is certifiable on a basic-open cover of the base but carries
16	no global certificate — so the faithful functor value is the **locally certified**
17	quotient `DivFamZar`. The generic germ-regularity engines live in
18	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit`.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertified` — the Addendum-2 frozen pin: a span-⊤ family
21	  `g : Fin m → R` with certified divisor families over `Localization.Away (g i)`
22	  divisor-equal to the pulled system; `hreg` is discharged by the Kit's open-immersion
23	  lemma, with the S4 instance provided by `haveI`.
24	* `IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq` — the pin respects divisor equality.
25	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified` — a global certificate is a local one
26	  (trivial cover `g = ![1]`; the certified part is `mapAlg` to `Localization.Away 1`,
27	  whose equations ARE the pulled system on the nose).
28	* `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the mapAlg-hreg
29	  engine**: a locally certified system has regular pulled equations along the
30	  comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'` — regularity is germ-local, each germ
31	  sits over a chart `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` of `R'`, where the
32	  local certificate's regularity transports through its `DivEq` and the landed
33	  certificate-based pullback regularity.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar` — the quotient of locally certified systems by
35	  `DivEq`, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `picClass`, and `DivFam.toZar`.
36	
37	Total `DivFamZar.mapAlg` and the Zariski keystones are
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`.
39	-/

60	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

62	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom π]

64	/-- **The Addendum-2 frozen pin** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): a
65	local-equation system on the relative curve is *locally certified* in degree `n` if
66	some span-⊤ family `g : Fin m → R` carries certified divisor families over the
67	localizations `Localization.Away (g i)` that are divisor-equal to the pulled system.
68	The pullback's regularity hypothesis is discharged once and for all by the Kit's
69	open-immersion lemma — the comparison of an away localization is an open immersion
70	(the S4 instance, provided by `haveI`). -/
71	def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
72	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
73	    ∀ i : Fin m,
74	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
75	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
76	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (g i)) π n,
77	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
78	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
79	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
80	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))

84	/-- **The locally certified pin respects divisor equality**: the local `DivEq`s
85	transport through `divEq_pullback` (regularity along the chart immersions is free). -/
86	theorem IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
87	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
88	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d' := by
89	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
90	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
91	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
92	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
93	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
94	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
95	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
96	      h _ _)⟩

98	/-- **A global certificate is a local one** (the trivial cover `g = ![1]`): the
99	certified part over `Localization.Away (1 : R)` is `mapAlg` of the family, whose
100	equations are the pulled system on the nose (`pulledEquations` IS the pullback along
101	the comparison; the regularity proofs are proof-irrelevant). -/
102	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified {n : ℕ}
103	    (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : IsLocallyCertified C R π n F.eqns := by
104	  refine ⟨1, fun _ => (1 : R), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
105	  · have hrange : Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : R)) = {1} := Set.range_const
106	    rw [hrange, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
107	  · haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (1 : R))) :=
108	      isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (1 : R)) 1
109	    exact ⟨F.mapAlg (Localization.Away (1 : R)) n,
110	      Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩

114	section MapAlgHreg
115	
116	variable {n : ℕ} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
118	
119	/-- **The mapAlg-hreg engine** (S5b): a locally certified system has regular pulled
120	equations along the comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'`. Regularity is
121	germ-local on the curve: the charts `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` cover
122	`relCurve C R'` by open immersions; over each, the composite comparison factors
123	through the certified chart `Localization.Away (g i)`, where the certificate's
124	pullback regularity (`DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`)
125	transports through the recorded `DivEq`. -/
126	theorem IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
127	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d)
128	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
129	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
130	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
131	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
132	  classical
133	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
134	  -- the away charts of `R'` at the pushed cover, and their immersions
135	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
136	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
138	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
140	  -- the pushed family spans the unit ideal of `R'`
141	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
143	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
150	        exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
151	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
152	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
153	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
154	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
155	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
156	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
158	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
159	  -- over the chart at `g i`: factor the composite through the certified localization
160	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
161	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
162	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
163	  -- the away map `Localization.Away (g i) → Localization.Away (φ (g i))` as an
164	  -- algebra tower
165	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i.down))
166	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
167	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
168	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
169	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
170	      (by
171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra
174	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
175	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
176	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
177	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
178	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
179	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
180	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
182	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
186	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])
188	  -- the comparison triangle through the two factorizations of `C_{T i} → C_R`
189	  have hcomp₁ : relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
190	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
191	      ≫ relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
192	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
193	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := Localization.Away (g i.down))
194	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
195	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
196	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
197	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
198	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R')
199	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
200	  have step1 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_congr hcomp₂ d ζ
201	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d
202	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
203	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) d) ζ
204	  have hfinal := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
205	    (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
206	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) hGdiv ζ
207	    (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
208	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
209	      G.certified.projective_colength ζ ζ
210	      ((G.eqns.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
211	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))).mem_opens ζ))
212	  exact ((step1.trans step2).symm ▸ hfinal)
213	
214	end MapAlgHreg

218	variable (C R π)
219	variable (n : ℕ)
220	
221	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on locally certified systems (Addendum 2's mirror of
222	`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
223	certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
224	def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
225	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
226	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
227	  iseqv :=
228	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
229	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
230	
231	/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
232	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
233	degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
234	a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
235	def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
236	
237	namespace DivFamZar
238	
239	variable {C R π n}
240	
241	/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
242	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
243	    DivFamZar C R π n :=
244	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩
245	
246	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
247	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
248	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
249	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
250	
251	/-- **The Picard class of a locally certified divisor class** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on
252	the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/
253	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
254	  Quotient.lift
255	    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
256	      d.1.picClass)
257	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F
258	
259	@[simp]
260	lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
261	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
262	  rfl
263	
264	end DivFamZar
265	
266	variable {C R π n}
267	
268	/-- **The comparison from the globally certified value**: a certified family is
269	locally certified (trivial cover), and divisor equality is the relation on both
270	sides. Over a field the two notions agree; over a general base `toZar` is the
271	sheafification-of-value comparison. -/
272	def DivFam.toZar : DivFam C R π n → DivFamZar C R π n :=
273	  Quotient.lift
274	    (fun F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n =>
275	      DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified)
276	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr h)
277	
278	@[simp]
279	lemma DivFam.toZar_mk (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) :
280	    (DivFam.mk F).toZar = DivFamZar.mk F.eqns F.isLocallyCertified :=
281	  rfl
282	
283	/-- The Picard class factors through `toZar`. -/
284	@[simp]
285	lemma DivFamZar.picClass_toZar (F : DivFam C R π n) :
286	    F.toZar.picClass = F.picClass := by
287	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
288	  | h F => rfl
289	
290	end AlgebraicGeometry

108	      (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a))

110	variable {C R π a} in
111	lemma mem_divisorWindow_iff {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
112	    {hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1}
113	    {x : R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)} :
114	    x ∈ divisorWindow d hH1 ↔
115	      relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1 x ∈
116	        (d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
117	          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) :=
118	  Iff.rfl
119	
120	variable {C R π a} in
121	/-- **Setoid invariance of the window submodule** (worksheet §2.3.4): divisor equality
122	does not move `K_a(d)` — the embedding `ε` is well defined on the quotient. -/
123	theorem divisorWindow_eq_of_divEq {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
124	    (h : d₁.DivEq d₂)
125	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1) :
126	    divisorWindow d₁ hH1 = divisorWindow d₂ hH1 := by
127	  rw [divisorWindow, divisorWindow,
128	    Scheme.LocalEquations.vanishingSubmodule_eq_of_divEq R h]
129	
130	variable {C R π a} in
131	/-- **The window submodule of a divisor family** (`ε`'s component at exponent `a`): the
132	descent of `divisorWindow` to the divisor functor value `DivFam C R π n`. -/
133	noncomputable def DivFam.window {n : ℕ} (F : DivFam C R π n)
134	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1) :
135	    Submodule R (R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) :=
136	  Quotient.lift
137	    (fun G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n => divisorWindow G.eqns hH1)
138	    (fun _ _ h => divisorWindow_eq_of_divEq h hH1) F
139	
140	variable {C R π a} in
141	@[simp]
142	lemma DivFam.window_mk {n : ℕ} (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n)
143	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1) :
144	    (DivFam.mk G).window hH1 = divisorWindow G.eqns hH1 :=
145	  rfl
146	
147	/-! ## The Task-4 bookkeeping over a chart adaptation -/
148	
149	section Carve
150	
151	variable {C R π a}
152	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
153	variable (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
154	
155	/-- **The window carve arrow** `R ⊗[k] H_a → W(d)^{Θᵃ}`: the Θ-twisted colength
156	evaluation through the window identification.  Its kernel is `K_a(d)`
157	(`ker_windowCarve`); its surjectivity is the open right-exactness heart of Task 4. -/
158	noncomputable def windowCarve :
159	    R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤) →ₗ[R]
160	      A.ThetaGlued a :=
161	  A.thetaGluedEval a ∘ₗ (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).toLinearMap
162	
163	/-- **Left exactness of the section sequence** (Task 4): the kernel of the window carve
164	arrow is exactly the window submodule `K_a(d)` — the sequence
165	`0 → K_a(d) → R ⊗[k] H_a → W(d)^{Θᵃ}` is exact. -/
166	theorem ker_windowCarve :
167	    LinearMap.ker (windowCarve A hH1) = divisorWindow d hH1 := by
168	  rw [windowCarve, LinearMap.ker_comp, A.ker_thetaGluedEval, divisorWindow]
169	
170	/-- Surjectivity of the carve arrow follows from surjectivity of the evaluation. -/
171	lemma windowCarve_surjective (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a)) :
172	    Function.Surjective (windowCarve A hH1) := by
173	  rw [windowCarve, LinearMap.coe_comp]
174	  exact hsurj.comp (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).surjective
175	
176	/-- **The corank identification** (Task 4, conditional on the right-exactness heart):
177	once the evaluation is surjective, the quotient of the free window by `K_a(d)` is the
178	Θ-twisted colength module `W(d)^{Θᵃ}`. -/
179	noncomputable def windowQuotEquiv (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a)) :
180	    ((R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) ⧸
181	        divisorWindow d hH1) ≃ₗ[R] A.ThetaGlued a :=
182	  (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ker_windowCarve A hH1).symm).trans
183	    ((windowCarve A hH1).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (windowCarve_surjective A hH1 hsurj))
184	
185	variable (n : ℕ)
186	
187	/-- **The conditional Grassmannian point** (worksheet §2.3 step 3, corank certificate):
188	given the right-exactness heart (surjectivity of the evaluation) and a
189	finite-projective rank-`n` certificate for the Θ-twisted colength module `W(d)^{Θᵃ}`,
190	the window submodule `K_a(d)` is a point of the affine Grassmannian functor
191	`grFunctorAff k H_a n R`.  The rank-`n` input at the DD-0 windows is the certificate
192	clause (c2) transported across the twist — the remaining Task-4 obligation together
193	with surjectivity. -/
194	noncomputable def divisorWindowGr (hsurj : Function.Surjective (A.thetaGluedEval a))
195	    (hfin : Module.Finite R (A.ThetaGlued a))
196	    (hproj : Module.Projective R (A.ThetaGlued a))
197	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk (A.ThetaGlued a) p = n) :
198	    Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k
199	      (↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)) n R where
200	  toSubmodule := divisorWindow d hH1
201	  finite_quotient :=
202	    letI := hfin
203	    Module.Finite.equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj).symm
204	  projective_quotient :=
205	    letI := hproj
206	    Module.Projective.of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj).symm
207	  rankAtStalk_eq := fun p => by
208	    rw [congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv (windowQuotEquiv A hH1 hsurj)) p]
209	    exact hrank p

6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0Functor
7	
8	/-!
9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
10	
11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
17	
18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
19	
20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
30	
31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
32	
33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
40	
41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
42	
43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
56	
57	## Main declarations
58	
59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
67	-/
68	
69	set_option autoImplicit false
70	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
71	
72	universe u
73	
74	open CategoryTheory Opposite
75	
76	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
77	
78	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
79	
80	/-- **The pinned representability datum** for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative
81	Picard functor of the curve `C` (w4-datum-worksheet §1.1, frozen).  Produced once, by
82	explicit construction, in Wave 4 (DAT-J: `jacobianData`); consumed as a section
83	variable everywhere else.  NEVER a sorried instance, NEVER `Nonempty` + choice.
84	
85	The typing of `rep` is chosen so that `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies verbatim with
86	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` (see `JacobianData.grpObj`). -/
87	structure JacobianData (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
88	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
89	    Type (u + 1) where
90	  /-- The representing object (the Jacobian-to-be). -/
91	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
92	  /-- The pinned universal datum: `Hom(T, J) ≃ Pic⁰(T)`, naturally in the test `T`. -/
93	  rep : ((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J
94	  /-- Certificate from the construction (Kleiman 4.8(1) shape); NOT re-derived via the
95	  EGA limit criterion. -/
96	  locallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom
97	  /-- Certificate from the construction (a posteriori: `|J|` is the image of a
98	  quasi-compact divisor scheme under the Abel map).  Feeds `IsProper` (Wave 5) via
99	  `finite type = qc + lft`. -/
100	  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact J.hom
101	
102	namespace JacobianData
103	
104	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
105	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
106	
107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
112	@[implicit_reducible]
113	noncomputable def grpObj (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj d.J :=
114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
115	
116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
121	  d.rep.homEquiv
122	
123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
130	
131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep
136	
137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm
145	
146	end JacobianData
147	
148	/-! ## η-defeq smoke tests (recon §5 lower-order unknown; `example`-level, nothing
149	registered)
150	
151	The first test records that `Over.mk d.J.hom ≡ d.J` definitionally (structure eta); the
152	second that instance resolution crosses it — `smooth_of_grpObj`'s hypothesis
153	`[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]` at `f := d.J.hom` is discharged by `letI := d.grpObj`; the third
154	that mathlib's `IsClosedImmersion η[d.J].left` instance fires on `d.J` as-is.  T-chain
155	and S2 depend on these; if a mathlib bump ever breaks them, a transport lemma must be
156	added HERE, not in the consumers. -/
157	
158	section EtaDefeqSmokeTests
159	
160	open MonObj
161	
162	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
163	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
164	
165	/-- Smoke test 1: `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally `d.J` — the ascription
166	elaborates with no transport. -/
167	noncomputable example (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj
168	
169	/-- Smoke test 2: `smooth_of_grpObj` applies to `d.J.hom` with no transport lemma;
170	the group instance must be *keyed* at `Over.mk d.J.hom` (the ascribed `letI` below —
171	instance search does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own, but the ascription is pure
172	defeq). -/
173	example (d : JacobianData C) [GeometricallyReduced d.J.hom] : Smooth d.J.hom :=
174	  letI := d.locallyOfFiniteType
175	  letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj
176	  smooth_of_grpObj d.J.hom
177	
178	/-- Smoke test 3: the unit section of `d.J` is a closed immersion (mathlib's
179	group-scheme instance fires on `d.J` directly, with the datum's group structure in
180	scope). -/
181	example (d : JacobianData C) [GrpObj d.J] : IsClosedImmersion η[d.J].left :=
182	  inferInstance
183	
184	end EtaDefeqSmokeTests
185	
186	end AlgebraicGeometry

69	/-- **A surjection of finite projective modules of equal rank at every stalk is
70	injective** (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 5, the equality mechanism): the projective
71	lifting splits the surjection, so the kernel is a finite projective direct summand
72	whose rank at every stalk is zero — a subsingleton, by
73	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_iff_subsingleton`. -/
74	theorem LinearMap.injective_of_surjective_of_rankAtStalk_eq
75	    {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N]
76	    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M] [Module.Projective R N]
77	    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
78	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
79	      Module.rankAtStalk M p = Module.rankAtStalk N p) :
80	    Function.Injective φ := by
81	  -- a right inverse of `φ` (the projective lifting), and the induced splitting
82	  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := φ.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
83	  obtain ⟨e, he₁, -⟩ := (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map φ).splitSurjectiveEquiv
84	    (Submodule.injective_subtype (LinearMap.ker φ)) ⟨l, hl⟩
85	  -- the kernel is a finite projective direct summand
86	  haveI : Module.Finite R N := Module.Finite.of_surjective φ hsurj
87	  haveI : Module.Finite R ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) :=
88	    Module.Finite.of_surjective
89	      (LinearMap.fst R ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) N ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap)
90	      (Prod.fst_surjective.comp e.surjective)
91	  haveI : Module.Projective R ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) :=
92	    Module.Projective.of_split (LinearMap.ker φ).subtype
93	      (LinearMap.fst R ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) N ∘ₗ e.toLinearMap)
94	      (LinearMap.ext fun x => by
95	        have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun he₁ x
96	        simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply] at hx ⊢
97	        rw [hx, e.apply_symm_apply]
98	        rfl)
99	  -- the kernel has rank zero at every stalk
100	  have hker : Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) = 0 := by
101	    funext p
102	    have h1 := congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e) p
103	    have h2 := congrFun (Module.rankAtStalk_prod (R := R) ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) N) p
104	    rw [Pi.add_apply] at h2
105	    have h3 := hrank p
106	    rw [Pi.zero_apply]
107	    omega
108	  haveI : Subsingleton ↥(LinearMap.ker φ) :=
109	    Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_iff_subsingleton.mp hker
110	  exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (Submodule.eq_bot_of_subsingleton)
111	
112	/-- **Nested submodules with same-rank finite projective quotients are equal**: the
113	canonical surjection `M ⧸ K₁ → M ⧸ K₂` is injective by the rank engine, so the larger
114	submodule collapses onto the smaller. -/
115	theorem Submodule.eq_of_le_of_rankAtStalk_quotient_eq
116	    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {K₁ K₂ : Submodule R M} (hle : K₁ ≤ K₂)
117	    [Module.Finite R (M ⧸ K₁)] [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ K₁)]
118	    [Module.Projective R (M ⧸ K₂)]
119	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
120	      Module.rankAtStalk (M ⧸ K₁) p = Module.rankAtStalk (M ⧸ K₂) p) :
121	    K₁ = K₂ := by
122	  have hcomap : K₁ ≤ K₂.comap LinearMap.id := hle
123	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Submodule.mapQ K₁ K₂ LinearMap.id hcomap) := by
124	    intro y
125	    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective K₂ y
126	    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, rfl⟩
127	  have hinj := LinearMap.injective_of_surjective_of_rankAtStalk_eq _ hsurj hrank
128	  refine le_antisymm hle fun x hx => ?_
129	  have h0 : Submodule.mapQ K₁ K₂ LinearMap.id hcomap (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = 0 := by
130	    rw [Submodule.mapQ_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
131	    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero K₂).mpr hx
132	  have hx0 : (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : M ⧸ K₁) = 0 := hinj (by rw [h0, map_zero])
133	  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero K₁).mp hx0
134	
135	end RankEngine

352	theorem eq_of_isDivRepClassify (F₀ F₁ : DivFamZar C S π g)
353	    {v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
354	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)

361	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀

366	  -- the product cover, `ULift`ed into the working universe
367	  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range
368	      fun p : ULift.{u} (Fin m₀) × ULift.{u} (Fin m₁) => c₀ p.1.down * c₁ p.2.down)

371	        (fun p : ULift.{u} (Fin m₀) × ULift.{u} (Fin m₁) => (p.1.down, p.2.down)) := by
372	      rintro ⟨a, b⟩
373	      exact ⟨(⟨a⟩, ⟨b⟩), rfl⟩
374	    have hrange := hsurj.range_comp (fun q : Fin m₀ × Fin m₁ => c₀ q.1 * c₁ q.2)

380	  -- the first carrier maps to the refinement

388	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by

391	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=

395	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away (c₁ p₁)) (c₁ p₁)
396	      (g := algebraMap S (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)))
397	      (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)
398	        (dvd_mul_left (c₁ p₁) (c₀ p₀)))).toAlgebra
399	  haveI : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (c₁ p₁))
400	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=

403	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (c₁ p₁))

10	/-!
11	# Conditional assembly kit for affine divisor representability
12	
13	This file isolates the formal tail between a chart-wise universal certified family and
14	the affine equivalence of DDR-9.F6.  It deliberately makes the remaining F5 hypotheses
15	explicit:
16	
17	* `divRepPullAt` pulls a supplied chart family along a map out of a carve-chart ring;
18	* `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible` is the exact choice-independence statement needed to
19	  glue those local pullbacks;
20	* `DivRepAffinePullback` packages the output of that glue together with the two laws and
21	  naturality;
22	* `DivRepAffinePullback.equiv` turns those data into the affine equivalence, using the
23	  already-landed uniqueness theorem for `divRepClassifyZar` for the hom-side law.
24	
25	No universal family, compatibility, inverse law, or representability theorem is asserted
26	here.  The future F5 construction must supply the fields of these interfaces.
27	-/

89	F5's affine forward map is glued. -/
90	noncomputable def divRepPullAt
91	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),

135	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j' →
136	      divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
137	        = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega'

145	    (hU : IsCompatible (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)

162	/-! ## F6: package a completed affine pullback as an equivalence -/
163	
164	/-- The exact output expected from F5 before the affine equivalence is packaged.
165	`isDivRepClassify_pull` is the hom-side law in the refinement-stable clause spelling;
166	classifier uniqueness turns it into the second inverse law automatically. -/
167	structure DivRepAffinePullback where
168	  pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S],
169	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) → DivFamZar C S pi g
170	  pull_classify : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
171	    (F : DivFamZar C S pi g),
172	    pull S (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F) = F
173	  isDivRepClassify_pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
174	    (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver),
175	    IsDivRepClassify hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 (pull S v) v.left
176	  pull_naturality : ∀ {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
177	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B) (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver),
178	    pull B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v) = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (pull A v)

182	/-- The affine representability equivalence assembled from an F5 pullback package.
183	The inverse is the landed backward classifier; its hom-side inverse law follows from
184	`divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify`. -/
185	noncomputable def equiv
186	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
187	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
188	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) ≃ DivFamZar C S pi g where
189	  toFun := D.pull S
190	  invFun := divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S
191	  left_inv v :=
192	    (divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
193	      (D.pull S v) v (D.isDivRepClassify_pull S v)).symm
194	  right_inv := D.pull_classify S

196	@[simp]

198	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
199	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) :
200	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
201	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S v = D.pull S v :=
202	  rfl
203	
204	@[simp]
205	theorem equiv_symm_apply
206	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
207	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (F : DivFamZar C S pi g) :
208	    (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
209	      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S).symm F
210	      = divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F :=
211	  rfl

213	/-- Naturality of the assembled affine equivalence, in the frozen DDR-9 spelling. -/
214	theorem equiv_naturality
215	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
216	    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
217	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
218	    (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver) :
219	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
220	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v)
221	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi
222	          (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
223	            (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D A v) :=
224	  D.pull_naturality phi v

10	/-!
11	# F4 — the backward direction of `divRepAff` at the Zar layer
12	(`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §2.1, steps 1, 3, 5, 6)
13	
14	A locally certified divisor class `F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g` over an affine test `S`
15	classifies to a **unique** morphism `overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g` — the content of
16	`divRepAff.symm`.  Construction: the composite certificate × frame cover of the Kit
17	(`DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover`), `divClassify` fired at each certified
18	representative with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`), the glue by
19	`Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms` with overlap agreement through the clause-transport
20	layer, and the Over packaging by `divSchemeOverHomMk` (F2).
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsDivRepClassify` — **the characterizing clause** (the
23	  refinement-stable form F6 consumes): over EVERY `k`/`S`-tower test `T` carrying a
24	  certified representative `G` of the restricted class and a pair-chart framing of
25	  `ε (DivFam.mk G)`, the morphism chart-factors.  No localization hypothesis on `T`
26	  — stability under refinement of covers and change of representative is built into
27	  the quantifier.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divClassifyZar` — **the ∃!-keystone**: `F₀` classifies to a
29	  unique clause-satisfier `Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` (overlap layer:
30	  `Picard/DivRepClassifyZarCompat.lean`).
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepClassifyZar` — **the keystone map**
32	  `DivFamZar C S π g → (overSpec k S ⟶ divSchemeOver g)`, with the characterizing
33	  lemma `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify` and the well-definedness lemma
34	  `divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify` (any Over-hom whose scheme morphism
35	  satisfies the clause IS the classified one — Law 2's uniqueness input).
36	-/

63	  [IsIntegral C.left]

65	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
66	  [IsDominant π]

68	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

70	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]

75	variable (r₁ r₂ : ℕ)

77	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))

83	/-- **The characterizing clause of the backward classification** (w4-ddr9 §2.1
84	step 6, the refinement-stable form): over EVERY `k`/`S`-tower test `T` carrying a
85	certified representative `G` of the restriction of `F₀` and a pair-chart framing of
86	`ε (DivFam.mk G)`, the restriction of `v` composes with `divSchemeι` to the chart
87	morphism of the framing.  Quantifying over all tests and all representatives makes
88	the clause stable under refinement of covers and change of representative by
89	construction — F6's Law 1/Law 2 consume it without unfolding any choice. -/
90	def IsDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
91	    (v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
92	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
93	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
94	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)) : Prop :=
95	  ∀ (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra k T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower k S T]
96	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C T π g),
97	    (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg T g F₀ →
98	    ∀ (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
99	      (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] T),
100	      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
101	          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
102	              (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1 →
103	      (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
104	          = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)
105	              (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).2 →
106	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))
107	          ≫ v ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
108	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
109	            (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
110	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w.toRingHom) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j

116	/-- **Existence half of the backward classification** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 steps 3 and 5):
117	the per-piece `divClassify` outputs over the composite certificate × frame cover —
118	with the carve discharged by DDR-9.0 (`divFamEps_carve`) — glue to a morphism
119	`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
120	theorem exists_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
121	    ∃ v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
122	        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
123	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
124	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
125	      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
126	  classical
127	  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
128	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
129	  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
130	  have hv : ∀ p : Fin m,
131	      ∃ vp : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (r p))) ⟶
132	        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
133	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
134	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
135	      DivClassifyClause hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (G p)) vp := fun p =>
136	    (divClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (G p))
137	      (fun a => divFamEps_carve C π hπ g (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) a)).exists
138	  choose v hvc using hv
139	  have hglue : ∀ p q : Fin m,
140	      pullback.fst ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
141	          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p)
142	        ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
143	          (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f q) ≫ v p
144	      = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ v q := fun p q =>
145	    pullback_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
146	      (DivFam.mk (G p)) (DivFam.mk (G q)) (hZ p) (hZ q) (hvc p) (hvc q)
147	  refine ⟨(Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
148	    (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.glueMorphisms v hglue, ?_⟩
149	  intro T _ _ _ _ GT hGT i j ω hω₁ hω₂
150	  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
151	    ((Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
152	      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.pullback₁
153	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))))
154	    _ _ fun p => ?_
155	  change pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _
156	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition, Category.assoc,
157	    Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms_assoc]
158	  exact (pullback_chart_divClassifyClause_compat hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
159	    GT hGT ω hω₁ hω₂ (DivFam.mk (G p)) (hZ p) (hvc p)).symm

162	include hO hχ in
163	/-- **Uniqueness / full choice-independence** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 step 6): any two
164	morphisms satisfying the characterizing clause for `F₀` agree — compare over the
165	composite certificate × frame cover (`divScheme_hom_ext` per piece,
166	`Scheme.Cover.hom_ext` globally).  In particular the classified morphism does not
167	depend on the choice of representatives, certificate cover, or frame covers. -/
168	theorem isDivRepClassify_unique (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
169	    {v v' : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
170	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
171	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
172	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)}
173	    (hv : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v)
174	    (hv' : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v') : v = v' := by
175	  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
176	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
177	  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
178	  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext
179	    (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
180	      (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover _ _ fun p => ?_
181	  refine divScheme_hom_ext k _ _ g r₁ r₂ b₁ (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
182	    _ _ ?_
183	  have h1 : (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
184	        (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p
185	        ≫ v ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
186	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
187	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
188	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw p).toRingHom)
189	          ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ (ci p) (cj p) :=
190	    hv (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)
191	  have h2 : (Scheme.affineOpenCoverOfSpanRangeEqTop
192	        (R := CommRingCat.of S) r hspan).openCover.f p
193	        ≫ v' ≫ divSchemeι k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
194	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
195	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)
196	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cw p).toRingHom)
197	          ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ (ci p) (cj p) :=
198	    hv' (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p) (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)
199	  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
200	  exact h1.trans h2.symm

202	include hO hχ in
203	/-- **The ∃!-keystone of the backward direction** (w4-ddr9 §2.1): a locally
204	certified divisor class over an affine test classifies to a UNIQUE morphism
205	`Spec S ⟶ DivScheme g` satisfying the characterizing clause. -/
206	theorem divClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
207	    ∃! v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
208	        DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
209	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
210	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
211	      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v := by
212	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
213	  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' =>
214	    isDivRepClassify_unique hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ hv' hv⟩
215	
216	/-! ## The Over packaging -/
217	
218	include hO hχ in
219	/-- **The classified morphism, packaged over `Spec k`**: the clause-satisfier carries
220	the Over-triangle — its `divSchemeι`-composite is chart-presented over the composite
221	certificate × frame cover, so `divSchemeOverHomMk` (F2) applies. -/
222	theorem exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
223	    ∃ u : overSpec k S ⟶
224	        divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
225	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
226	          (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm),
227	      IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ u.left := by
228	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
229	  obtain ⟨m, r, hspan, hdata⟩ :=
230	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
231	  choose G ci cj cw hZ hcw₁ hcw₂ using hdata
232	  exact ⟨divSchemeOverHomMk k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
233	    (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
234	    (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm) v r hspan
235	    (fun p => ⟨ci p, cj p, cw p,
236	      hv (Localization.Away (r p)) (G p) (hZ p) (ci p) (cj p) (cw p)
237	        (hcw₁ p) (hcw₂ p)⟩), hv⟩
238	
239	variable (S) in
240	/-- **The keystone of F4** (w4-ddr9 §2.1, `divRepAff.symm`'s content): the backward
241	classification of locally certified divisor classes over an affine test, as a
242	morphism of `Over (Spec k)`.  Characterized by `divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify`;
243	independent of every choice by `divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify`. -/
244	noncomputable def divRepClassifyZar (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
245	    overSpec k S ⟶
246	      divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
247	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
248	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm) :=
249	  (exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀).choose
250	
251	include hO hχ in
252	/-- **The characterizing lemma of `divRepClassifyZar`** (the F6 interface): the
253	classified morphism satisfies the clause — over every `k`/`S`-tower test with a
254	certified representative of the restricted class and a pair-chart framing of its ε
255	pair, it restricts to the chart morphism. -/
256	theorem divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
257	    IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
258	      (divRepClassifyZar hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S F₀).left :=
259	  (exists_overHom_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀).choose_spec
260	
261	include hO hχ in
262	/-- **Well-definedness / the uniqueness interface of `divRepClassifyZar`** (Law 2's
263	input): ANY morphism of `Over (Spec k)` whose underlying scheme morphism satisfies
264	the characterizing clause for `F₀` is the classified morphism. -/
265	theorem divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g)
266	    (u : overSpec k S ⟶
267	      divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
268	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
269	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm))
270	    (hu : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ u.left) :
271	    u = divRepClassifyZar hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S F₀ :=
272	  Over.OverMorphism.ext (isDivRepClassify_unique hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ hu
273	    (divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀))
274

341	/-- **The separation theorem** (w4-ddr9 §2.1, the class side of step 6): two locally
342	certified divisor classes over an affine test that are classified by the SAME morphism
343	are equal.  Together with `isDivRepClassify_unique` — the hom side — the characterizing
344	clause is therefore a *bijective* correspondence on the nose.
345	
346	Proof: the composite certificate × frame cover of each class, refined against the other
347	by the product cover (`span_range_mul_eq_top`); at each common away carrier the two
348	chart presentations of `v` coincide, so `mapAlg_eq_of_certChartFrames` equates the
349	restricted classes; `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` globalizes.
350	
351	No certificate over the whole chart ring and no DDR9-U ε-identity is consumed. -/
352	theorem eq_of_isDivRepClassify (F₀ F₁ : DivFamZar C S π g)
353	    {v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
354	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
355	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁
356	        (b₂.map (windowShiftEquiv hπ g).symm)}
357	    (h₀ : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ v)
358	    (h₁ : IsDivRepClassify hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₁ v) : F₀ = F₁ := by
359	  classical
360	  obtain ⟨m₀, c₀, hspan₀, hdata₀⟩ :=
361	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀
362	  obtain ⟨m₁, c₁, hspan₁, hdata₁⟩ :=
363	    DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₁
364	  choose G₀ ci₀ cj₀ cw₀ hZ₀ hfst₀ hsnd₀ using hdata₀
365	  choose G₁ ci₁ cj₁ cw₁ hZ₁ hfst₁ hsnd₁ using hdata₁
366	  -- the product cover, `ULift`ed into the working universe
367	  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range
368	      fun p : ULift.{u} (Fin m₀) × ULift.{u} (Fin m₁) => c₀ p.1.down * c₁ p.2.down)
369	      = ⊤ := by
370	    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
371	        (fun p : ULift.{u} (Fin m₀) × ULift.{u} (Fin m₁) => (p.1.down, p.2.down)) := by
372	      rintro ⟨a, b⟩
373	      exact ⟨(⟨a⟩, ⟨b⟩), rfl⟩
374	    have hrange := hsurj.range_comp (fun q : Fin m₀ × Fin m₁ => c₀ q.1 * c₁ q.2)
375	    exact hrange ▸ span_range_mul_eq_top c₀ c₁ hspan₀ hspan₁
376	  refine DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq
377	    (fun p : ULift.{u} (Fin m₀) × ULift.{u} (Fin m₁) => c₀ p.1.down * c₁ p.2.down)
378	    (fun p => Localization.Away (c₀ p.1.down * c₁ p.2.down)) hspan ?_
379	  rintro ⟨⟨p₀⟩, ⟨p₁⟩⟩
380	  -- the first carrier maps to the refinement
381	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀)) (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
382	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away (c₀ p₀)) (c₀ p₀)
383	      (g := algebraMap S (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)))
384	      (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)
385	        (dvd_mul_right (c₀ p₀) (c₁ p₁)))).toAlgebra
386	  haveI : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀))
387	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
388	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
389	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
390	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀))
391	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
392	    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := S)
393	  -- and so does the second
394	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (c₁ p₁)) (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
395	    (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away (c₁ p₁)) (c₁ p₁)
396	      (g := algebraMap S (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)))
397	      (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)
398	        (dvd_mul_left (c₁ p₁) (c₀ p₀)))).toAlgebra
399	  haveI : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (c₁ p₁))
400	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
401	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
402	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
403	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (c₁ p₁))
404	      (Localization.Away (c₀ p₀ * c₁ p₁)) :=
405	    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := S)
406	  exact mapAlg_eq_of_certChartFrames hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ F₁ h₀ h₁
407	    (G₀ p₀) (hZ₀ p₀) (cw₀ p₀) (hfst₀ p₀) (hsnd₀ p₀)
408	    (G₁ p₁) (hZ₁ p₁) (cw₁ p₁) (hfst₁ p₁) (hsnd₁ p₁)
409	
410	include hO hχ in
411	/-- **The keystone map is injective** (the F6 Law-1 input): distinct locally certified
412	divisor classes over an affine test classify to distinct morphisms.  Immediate from
413	`eq_of_isDivRepClassify` and the characterizing lemma. -/
414	theorem divRepClassifyZar_injective :
415	    Function.Injective (divRepClassifyZar (C := C) (π := π) hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S) := by
416	  intro F₀ F₁ h
417	  refine eq_of_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ F₁
418	    (v := (divRepClassifyZar hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ S F₁).left)
419	    ?_ (divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₁)
420	  rw [← h]
421	  exact divRepClassifyZar_isDivRepClassify hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀

11	/-!
12	# Certified divisor families: the DD-1 carrier (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §1)
13	
14	The Wave-4 DAT-D divisor functor's object data over an affine test `R`, the worksheet's
15	(D1) pin (`informal/dat-d-worksheet.md` §1.1): a `LocalEquations` system `d` on the
16	relative curve `C_R = relCurve C R`, a **finite chart adaptation** refining it — finitely
17	many basic opens `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts with partition witnesses, carrying
18	regular equations `f_j` that agree with `d`'s equations up to units — and the **colength
19	certificate**: the chart-local colength modules `Γ(D(h_j))/(f_j)` are finite projective
20	over `R`, and the glued equalizer module `W(d)` is finite projective of constant fibre
21	rank `n` (`Module.rankAtStalk`), with the two flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4) that make
22	certificates base-change (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FlatCokernel`).
23	
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData` — the `Fin`-indexed basic-open cover data (`Type u`;
25	  DAT-1's `BasicOpenCoverData` shape is `Type (u+1)`, unusable inside a functor value).
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation` — the adaptation: equations + the pointwise
27	  refinement-up-to-units clause `eqn_rel` (point-free, so it pulls back along arbitrary
28	  morphisms), with the anchored constructor `DivisorAdaptation.ofAnchors`.
29	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedSubmodule` — the glued colength module
30	  `W(d) = ker (δ⁻ − δ⁺) ⊆ Π_j Γ(D(h_j))/(f_j)`, with the equalizer description
31	  `mem_gluedSubmodule_iff` (the worksheet's `eq(∏_j ⇉ ∏_{j,j'})`).
32	* `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified` — the certificate (c1)–(c4).
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq` — divisor equality of local-equation
34	  systems: on a common refinement the equations agree up to units (refinement +
35	  rescaling in one move), an equivalence relation with
36	  `picClass_eq_of_divEq` (the class laws `picClass_restrict`/`picClass_rescale`).
37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily`, `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFam` — the certified
38	  family and the setoid quotient `DivFam C π n R : Type u`, the divisor functor's value
39	  on the affine test `R`, with `DivFam.picClass`.
40	
41	The `R`-algebra structure on section rings is `Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` through
42	`relCurve.instOver` (LOCAL instances, house rule) — consumers must activate the same
43	instances.
44	-/

56	/-! ## Divisor equality of local-equation systems (the setoid relation)
57	
58	Generic in the scheme; this is pure `DivisorClass`-level material. -/
59	
60	namespace Scheme.LocalEquations
61	
62	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
63	
64	/-- Restriction of a section along `W ≤ V ≤ U` composes to restriction along `W ≤ U`. -/
65	private lemma res_res {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
66	    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
67	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
68	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
69	
70	/-- **Divisor equality** of two local-equation systems: on a common refinement of the
71	two covers, the equations agree up to a unit at every point — common refinement plus
72	unit rescaling in a single move (the `CechPic`-pattern setoid of the DD-1 spec). -/
73	def DivEq (d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations) : Prop :=
74	  ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ d₁.cover) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ d₂.cover),
75	    ∀ x : X, ∃ u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ,
76	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁ x)).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
77	        = (u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x))
78	          * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂ x)).op).hom (d₂.eqn x)
79	
80	lemma divEq_refl (d : X.LocalEquations) : DivEq d d :=
81	  ⟨d.cover, le_rfl, le_rfl, fun _ => ⟨1, by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩⟩
82	
83	lemma DivEq.symm {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) : DivEq d₂ d₁ := by
84	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
85	  refine ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, fun x => ?_⟩
86	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
87	  exact ⟨u⁻¹, by
88	    rw [hu, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩
89	
90	lemma DivEq.trans {d₁ d₂ d₃ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) (h' : DivEq d₂ d₃) :
91	    DivEq d₁ d₃ := by
92	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
93	  obtain ⟨𝒱, k₂, k₃, K⟩ := h'
94	  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒱, fun x => (inf_le_left (b := 𝒱.opens x)).trans (h₁ x),
95	    fun x => (inf_le_right (a := 𝒲.opens x)).trans (k₃ x), fun x => ?_⟩
96	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
97	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := K x
98	  have E1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
99	    (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom hu
100	  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E1
101	  have E2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
102	    (inf_le_right : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x)).op).hom hv
103	  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E2
104	  refine ⟨X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u * X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v, ?_⟩
105	  have hcast : ∀ (w : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x)ˣ), (w : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x))
106	      = w.val := fun _ => rfl
107	  rw [Units.val_mul]
108	  calc (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
109	      = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val
110	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((inf_le_right).trans (k₂ x))).op).hom (d₂.eqn x) := by
111	        rw [show (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
112	            𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x) u).val
113	            = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
114	                𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom u.val from rfl]
115	        exact E1
116	    _ = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val * ((X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v).val
117	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((inf_le_right).trans (k₃ x))).op).hom (d₃.eqn x)) := by
118	        rw [show (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right :
119	            𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x) v).val
120	            = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
121	                𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x)).op).hom v.val from rfl]
122	        rw [E2]
123	    _ = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val * (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v).val
124	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op).hom (d₃.eqn x) := by
125	        rw [mul_assoc]
126	
127	/-- Structure extensionality for local-equation systems: the two `Prop` fields are
128	proof-irrelevant, so a system is determined by its cover and equations. -/
129	private lemma ext_eqn {d e : X.LocalEquations} (hcov : d.cover = e.cover)
130	    (heqn : d.eqn ≍ e.eqn) : d = e := by
131	  cases d; cases e
132	  cases hcov; cases heqn
133	  rfl
134	
135	/-- **Divisor equality preserves the Picard class** (`𝒪(D)` depends only on the divisor):
136	restrict both systems to the common refinement (`picClass_restrict`), where they differ
137	by a unit rescaling (`picClass_rescale`). -/
138	theorem picClass_eq_of_divEq {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) :
139	    d₁.picClass = d₂.picClass := by
140	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
141	  rw [← d₁.picClass_restrict 𝒲 h₁, ← d₂.picClass_restrict 𝒲 h₂]
142	  have hres : d₁.restrict 𝒲 h₁ = (d₂.restrict 𝒲 h₂).rescale (fun x => (H x).choose) := by
143	    refine ext_eqn rfl (heq_of_eq (funext fun x => ?_))
144	    exact (H x).choose_spec
145	  rw [hres, picClass_rescale]
146	
147	end Scheme.LocalEquations
